changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE estate_fees ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id uuid, branch_id uuid, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, created_by varchar(255), updated_at timestamptz, updated_by varchar(255), deleted boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
estate_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES estates (id),
-- Which declaration this row belongs to. The current schedule -- is the highest version; earlier ones are history, not noise. version integer NOT NULL,
-- APPLICATION | SETTING_OUT | INFRASTRUCTURE | -- CONSTRUCTION_SUPERVISION | FACILITY_MANAGEMENT | SURVEY | -- LEGAL | OTHER. Every one of these appears in the source -- letters; none was invented to look thorough. fee_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
-- Required for OTHER, so an unlabelled "other" charge cannot -- be disclosed as a number with no name. label varchar(128),
-- A fixed fee carries amount; a variable one carries the -- range instead. Never both, never neither — see the CHECK. amount numeric(19,4), amount_min numeric(19,4), amount_max numeric(19,4), currency varchar(3) NOT NULL,
is_fixed boolean NOT NULL,
-- Why a variable fee varies, in the developer's own words. -- Both letters say infrastructure is "subject to change due -- to fluctuations in the prices of building materials" — -- which is a genuine constraint, not necessarily a trick. -- Cement prices really do move. What is NOT permitted is -- silence. variation_basis text,
-- AT_APPLICATION | AT_ALLOCATION | ON_CONSTRUCTION_START | -- ON_MILESTONE | ANNUAL | BEFORE_OCCUPATION due_trigger varchar(32) NOT NULL,
refundable boolean NOT NULL, is_mandatory boolean NOT NULL, notes text,
CONSTRAINT uq_estate_fees_version_type UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (estate_id, version, fee_type, label),
-- A fixed fee has an amount and no range; a variable one has -- a range and no amount. Anything else is a figure nobody -- can act on. CONSTRAINT ck_estate_fees_fixed_has_amount CHECK ((is_fixed AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount_min IS NULL AND amount_max IS NULL) OR (NOT is_fixed AND amount IS NULL AND amount_min IS NOT NULL AND amount_max IS NOT NULL)),
-- A range that runs backwards is a typo, not a range. CONSTRAINT ck_estate_fees_range_ordered CHECK (amount_min IS NULL OR amount_max >= amount_min),
-- A variable fee must say WHY it varies. This is the whole -- point of allowing ranges: the alternative to a stated basis -- is not a fixed price, it is silence. CONSTRAINT ck_estate_fees_variation_basis CHECK (is_fixed OR (variation_basis IS NOT NULL AND btrim(variation_basis) <> '')),
CONSTRAINT ck_estate_fees_amounts_positive CHECK ((amount IS NULL OR amount >= 0) AND (amount_min IS NULL OR amount_min >= 0)) );
CREATE INDEX idx_estate_fees_estate_version ON estate_fees (estate_id, version); CREATE INDEX idx_estate_fees_tenant_id ON estate_fees (tenant_id);
COMMENT ON TABLE estate_fees IS 'Charges beyond the land price, declared before an estate may be listed. Versioned: a ' 'revision writes a new version and leaves the old one intact, so a buyer''s ' 'acknowledgement can name what they were actually shown.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN estate_fees.is_mandatory IS 'A fee whose stated condition is ITSELF mandatory must be recorded as mandatory. Both ' 'source letters charge setting-out and supervision only "if you build" — and both also ' 'REQUIRE building (Double King clause 1 mandates a 4-bedroom terrace duplex, Top Rank ' 'clause 2 a 2-bedroom). Reading those fees as conditional is the natural reading of the ' 'documents and the wrong one: the buyer has no path that avoids them.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN estate_fees.due_trigger IS 'When the charge falls due. ANNUAL covers recurring obligations — both letters impose a ' 'yearly facility-management fee, Double King''s payable by 15 January, Top Rank''s ' '"subject to change by the appointed facility manager", i.e. open-ended. An open-ended ' 'recurring fee is representable as exactly that (is_fixed = false with a variation ' 'basis saying so) and must never be flattened into a number implying certainty.';
